versions.content: Safety Measures traceability Type: valid Description: Safety Measures shall be traceable according to ISO 26262 [1]. Rationale: Traceability is a main requirement of safety standards (see ISO 26262-8 clause 6.4.3.2. [1]). Safety measures are activities or technical solutions that support the fulfillment of safety requirements which includes safety mechanisms provided by AUTOSAR. Establishing traceability directly within AUTOSAR models increases consistency and reduces effort for the provision of safety documentation. Use Case: [UC_SAFEX_00001], [UC_SAFEX_00004], [UC_SAFEX_00005] Dependencies: [RS_SAFEX_00015] Supporting Material: 
